Create meteo input file for 3DCMCCFEM model from daily data

Source: R/make_inputs.R
make_meteo.Rd

make_meteo converts a data.frame of daily weather data (e.g. from a weather station or a climate model) into the site_meteo.txt file required by the model. For European sites the data can be taken from E-OBS with make_meteo_EOBS.

Usage

make_meteo(data, site, rad_unit = c("MJ", "W"), check = TRUE, outdir)

Arguments

data

data.frame with daily data. It must contain a column date (Date or "yyyy-mm-dd") or the columns Year, Month and n_days, and the columns Rg_f (global radiation), Tmax, Tmin (°C), Precip (mm day-1) and RH_f (\ computed as (Tmax+Tmin)/2 if missing), Ts_f, SWC, LAI, ET, WS_f (set to -9999 if missing).

site

Character: Name of the site. Used to construct output name

rad_unit

Character: unit of Rg_f: "MJ" (MJ m-2 day-1, model unit) or "W" (W m-2, daily mean). Default to "MJ"

check

Logical: check the result with check_meteo_3DFEM (without correcting it)? Default to TRUE

outdir

Character: path to the output directory.

Value

Invisibly, the meteo data.frame. The file site_meteo.txt is saved in outdir.

See also

make_meteo_EOBS, check_meteo_3DFEM, make_CCS
